method: Git main ancestry filtered by committer epoch; first-parent count reported as main commits.
Concentration uses nonmerge ancestors, excludes names explicitly containing [bot], normalizes exact same names/emails. Accounts are not verified people.
Latest 30 main PRs merged before cutoff in each repository. Formal premerge reviews exclude authors and known bot accounts. Local review and ordinary comments not counted.
100 evenly spaced commits per repository sampled for changed path counts, including docs/generated/lock files. Not a code-quality score.
Qualitative source samples deliberately include positive and negative implementation/tests, not random defect estimates. No applications or test suites executed.
